gates.note: CI alone never proves runtime correctness.

strong_rules: UNKNOWN never becomes PASS by inference.
A worker lane cannot self-promote to VERIFIED or DONE.
A platform build may not copy or fork shared engine logic merely to make the platform pass.
Shared-core changes require affected platform impact review.
Physical/runtime evidence is mandatory for claims about device acceleration, audio, installation, launch, thermal behavior or local inference.
A stale or conflicting claim blocks new overlapping implementation until reconciled.
Target inference profiles are platform-owned and benchmark-gated; no universal LLM/backend may be required across all targets.
Inference profile promotion requires target resource headroom, quality, latency/stability and fallback evidence; CI alone is insufficient.

temporary_worker_autonomy.policy: Only exact-scope catalog/needs.json metadata changes can use separately authenticated protected CI and transactional inbox. No reviewer G6 PASS, generic DONE, module certification, executable or runtime self-approval. Not active until merged and verified on main.
